songs.title: There You Are
songs.stylePrompt: warm melodic pop, I-V-vi-IV progression, breakdown before the final chorus, textured mood
songs.lyrics:
[intro]

[Verse 1: Male Vocal]
He crossed beside the newspaper stand
With rain dried silver on his coat
The corner bell turned green above him
But he forgot the way to go
A face from dances, gates, and summers
Was waiting past the taxi row

[Pre-Chorus: Female Vocal]
She held a parcel to her chest
And felt the years fall out of place
The crowded curb went far away right there

[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
Two steps stopped in the city glare
There You Are
No speech could catch that sudden smile
Returning from so far

[Verse 2: Female Vocal]
She saw the boy inside the man
The same kind eyes, the careful tie
He saw the ribbon in her hair
Though time had taught them both goodbye
The traffic waited, horns grew mild
As if the whole street heard them try

[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
Two steps stopped in the city glare
There You Are
No speech could catch that sudden smile
Returning from so far

[key-lift final chorus: Male and Female Duet Harmony]
There You Are
Years apart and one breath near
The crowded corner turns to gold
There You Are
